label: vynst: virtual locks
info:
Virtual locks to try vynst (inwendo ERP) smart locks with Node-RED, without any hardware.

1. Open "inwendo ERP" and enter the address of your installation and an API token (right: events, write).
2. Open the lock bridge "Vereinsheim (virtuell)" once and press Done: instance id and secret are created.
3. Deploy. In vynst open Settings > Smart locks, the Node-RED connection, and press "Sync devices"; give rights.
4. "Open" in the app: the command arrives over the vynst MQTT broker, the virtual lock opens, confirms and locks itself again after 5 s.
5. Reader: the inject node "reader: card 04A1B2C3" asks vynst whether the card may open the front door (set the card number at a person). Over http: POST /virtual-locks/front_door/reader {"credential": "04A1B2C3"}.

GET /virtual-locks shows the state and the history of the locks, POST /virtual-locks/front_door/jam {"jammed": true} makes the lock fail its commands (vynst logs the failure).
Replace the function nodes "virtual lock ..." by your relay (GPIO, Shelly, Modbus ...) and the inject node by your reader.
